meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给网页和终端界面做视觉体检,附截图证据和明确结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚改完页面或组件,想确认视觉上没跑偏。
copy.tagline_en: Visually check web and terminal UIs with screenshots and a clear verdict
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just changed a page or component and need to confirm it still looks right

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在你改完任何 UI 后先做截图或终端捕获取证，再派两个只读审查子代理并行核对，最后按页给出 PASS/REVISE/FAIL 结论。覆盖网页、终端界面和分页文档。
howto.when: 在你新建或修改任何网页、终端界面、分页文档之后，或问它某个页面、组件、TUI 看起来对不对时触发；没有渲染表面的纯后端或库逻辑不适用。

say.text: 帮我给刚改完的页面做一次视觉 QA，附截图和结论
say.note: 它先截图取证，再派两个审查代理并行核对

say.text: 这个 TUI 的边框和 CJK 宽字符有没有溢出？
say.note: 它渲染真实终端并跑宽度检查

say.text: 把这份 PDF 每一页都渲染出来对照参考稿
say.note: 逐页渲染，提取文字不算证据

howto.what_en: After you change any UI, Claude captures screenshots or terminal evidence, dispatches two read-only review subagents in parallel, and returns a per-page PASS/REVISE/FAIL verdict. Covers web, terminal, and paginated surfaces.
howto.when_en: Use after you build or change any web, terminal, or paginated UI, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Skip when there is no rendered surface, such as pure backend or library logic.

say_en.text: Run visual QA on the page I just changed, with screenshots and a verdict
say_en.note: It captures evidence, then dispatches two review agents

say_en.text: Does this TUI overflow its borders or CJK wide characters?
say_en.note: It renders a real terminal and runs a width check

say_en.text: Render every page of this PDF and compare it to the reference
say_en.note: Page by page; extracted text is not evidence
